subject: LumenRidge onboarding — request for no-PO pilot terms
messages:
From: Taylor Green <taylor.green@lumenridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenridge.com
Date: Sat, 1 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot onboarding & billing terms (LumenRidge)

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at LumenRidge is excited to move the pilot forward. We can start a 3-month pilot (up to $18k) immediately, but our procurement cycle is long and we typically invoice Net30. For the pilot we were hoping Redwood could accept invoices without a PO/PO number to avoid delaying start.

Quick details:
- Pilot value: $18,000 total (approx. $6k/month)
- Start window: week of Nov 3
- Deliverables: access to Redwood hosted API, one model variant, usage reporting

Attached: draft SOW and completed vendor onboarding questionnaire.

Can you let us know whether procurement needs to raise a PO for pilots under $25k, or if an exception is possible? If needed, we can do a short commercial addendum / signature.

Thanks — Taylor
Taylor Green
Head of Infrastructure Partnerships
LumenRidge
Attachments: LumenRidge_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf), procurement_questionnaire_filled.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot onboarding & billing terms (LumenRidge)

Karthik / Ben — forwarding a request from a target pilot (LumenRidge). They want to start Nov 3 and are asking to be invoiced without a PO for the pilot (under $25k).

Why this matters: quick pilot conversion is high-signal for product-led pipeline; we stand to convert to a Dedicated deal if pilot goes well. Financial impact is modest (~$18k).

Ask: can Procurement approve a no-PO exception for this pilot with conditions (e.g., signed SOW, W9 on file, Net30 invoice, and a PO to follow if they convert to a committed contract)? If yes, what internal ticket/approval do you need from me?

I’ve attached their SOW and questionnaire. LMK if you need additional info.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0142

Attachment: LumenRidge_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Vanessa — thanks for the context and the SOW. We generally require a PO for any supplier onboarding, but there is an established escalation path for low-dollar pilots. We can approve an exception under the following conditions: 

1) Signed SOW (final) and vendor W9 on file.
2) Finance to create an AP-only vendor record and issue a one-time Net30 invoice (no PO).
3) Procurement will record an exception ticket (JIRA:PROC-4782) and include a risk note.
4) Sales must confirm any expansion will be accompanied by a standard PO or a Dedicated contract.

If the above is satisfied, I can sign off today — I’ll need the final SOW and W9 uploaded to our vendor portal and confirmation that LumenRidge agrees to Net30 invoicing. Also confirm the approver list: Vanessa (Partnerships), Ben (Sales Eng), and Karthik (Procurement) will be the internal approvers on the ticket.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Taylor — thanks, we can proceed under the conditions Karthik outlined.

Next steps on our side:
- Please upload signed SOW (final) and W9 to the DocuSign/portal link we shared (or reply with the signed PDF).

- Procurement will file JIRA:PROC-4782 and attach the SOW/W9; internal approvers: Vanessa, Ben, Karthik.
